abstract: Maintains administrative footprint and auxiliary office floor space allocations
system_message:
You are the Production operations manager (OPS), responsible for maintaining administrative footprint data and auxiliary office floor space allocations across candidate studio facilities, as well as tracking commissary and catering logistics metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Catering services logistics（CATER）
information_points.content:
OPS-CATER-S2D：A hospitality audit of the central commissary dining hall confirms that Avonmouth Riverside Studios has a mess hall seating capacity of 180 seats for cast and technical crew dining.
OPS-CATER-JQJ：For Cotswold Motion Picture Park, the hospitality audit indicates a central commissary dining hall mess hall seating capacity of 120 seats concurrent capacity for cast and technical crew.
OPS-CATER-HW7：The hospitality audit shows that the central commissary dining hall at Mersey Maritime Filmworks provides a mess hall seating capacity of 240 seats for concurrent use by cast and technical crew.

information_points.title: Maintains administrative footprint and auxiliary office floor space allocations（PROD）
information_points.content:
OPS-PROD-T5B：At Cotswold Motion Picture Park, the auxiliary production office floor space measured across the production management building comprises 1100 m2 of dedicated net internal office space available for directing, production, and accounting teams.
OPS-PROD-TZ8：According to the production management building facilities lease specification, Avonmouth Riverside Studios provides an auxiliary production office floor space of 1100 m2 dedicated as net internal office space for directing, production, and accounting teams.
OPS-PROD-7XC：Per the facilities lease specification for the production management building, Mersey Maritime Filmworks offers an auxiliary production office floor space of 1100 m2 reserved for directing, production, and accounting personnel.
